summary: Tested Google Drive-powered /galerie page end-to-end. Backend /api/drive/albums returns configured:true with 1 album 'Galerie' containing 19 images (drive.google.com thumbnail URLs, w800 thumb + w2000 full). Frontend renders 19 gallery items in masonry, all images loaded (naturalWidth>0), lazy loading enabled, filters work (Tous + Galerie), lightbox opens with full-res image, next/prev navigation works, close works. No console errors — only a benign a11y warning about missing DialogContent Description.
